height-touch.$description: Button height and the hit area of small and icon buttons on touch screens.

border.$description: A field's edge: the strong border, leaning toward the text colour as far as border.ink says (all the way under the brutalist skin).

indent.$description: How far each level of a tree is inset: a chevron's width, so a child's label lines up under its parent's.

row-height.$description: Height of a tree row. Follows density.

row-height-touch.$description: Height of a tree row on touch screens. Never follows density.

width.$description: Narrower than a dialog: a short question and two answers read as one block.

row-height.$description: Minimum height of a body row. Follows density.

row-height-touch.$description: Minimum height of header and body rows that hold a checkbox, and of headers that sort, on touch screens, so the 44px hit areas of checkboxes in adjacent rows never overlap and a sort header is a whole target. Never follows density.

header-background.$description: Behind a sticky header, so rows scroll under an opaque band. Match it to the surface the table sits on.

day-size.$description: Width and height of a day button. Follows density.

day-size-touch.$description: Day button size on touch screens, so each day is a 44px target.

hour-height.$description: Height of one hour in a time grid, such as the week agenda. Half an hour still fits a line of text.

gutter-width.$description: Width of the hour labels beside a time grid.

edge.$description: Opacity of a tinted badge's edge in its tone: a quarter, up to the full tone where a skin inks its borders.

shadow.$description: The overlay elevation: the theme's soft shadow, plus the edge highlight and the hard offset shadow a skin may turn on.

weight.$description: The stressed phrase in a marketing headline, beside regular display text.

style.$description: normal or italic. A theme whose display face carries no heavier weight stresses with italic instead.

width.$description: Expanded width of the app sidebar.

width-collapsed.$description: Width of the icon rail when the sidebar is collapsed.

item-height.$description: Height of a navigation item. Follows density.

background.$description: Behind the sidebar. Match it to the page canvas for a quiet rail, or set surface.sunken to set it apart.

item-active.$description: Behind the item of the current page.

header-height.$description: Height of the top bar beside the sidebar.

width.$description: Width of a sheet that slides in from the start or end edge: the medium size.

width-sm.$description: Width of a small side sheet, such as a short filter list.

width-lg.$description: Width of a large side sheet, such as a record with a conversation.

measure.$description: Widest the content of a full screen sheet runs: the parts stay full bleed and their content keeps to a centred column this wide.

list-height.$description: Largest height of the result list before it scrolls.

panel-width.$description: Width of a dropdown panel in the top navigation.

height.$description: Height of a tab. Follows density.
